# The manifest

`vibefield.plugin.json` is the installed contract. It is EMITTED from a typed
`manifest.ts` by `plugin-build`'s manifest stage, canonicalized (keys sorted,
2-space indent, one trailing newline) so the same manifest always produces the
same bytes — the plugin's `manifestHash` and its packed artifact's sha256 both
derive from them.

## Top-level fields

| field | type | required | rules |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `manifestVersion` | `1` | yes | — |
| `id` | string | yes | `plugin id segments must match [a-z][a-z0-9-]* (dot-separated)` |
| `version` | string | yes | matches `/^\d+\.\d+\.\d+(-[0-9A-Za-z.-]+)?$/` |
| `title` | string | yes | at least 1 character; at most 80 characters |
| `description` | string | no | at most 500 characters |
| `icon` | string | no | asset paths are ./-relative POSIX, no .., no schemes |
| `engines` | { app: string, contracts: string, platforms?: `darwin` \| `linux` \| `win32`[] } | yes | — |
| `entries` | { renderer?: string, service?: string } | no | — |
| `host` | `worker` \| `process` | no | — |
| `activation` | `string[]` | yes | `each item: at most 128 characters; each item: activation events: onStartup \| on{Widget,Command,Surface,Service}:<owned id>; at most 64 item(s)` |
| `backgroundReason` | string | no | at least 1 character; at most 500 characters |
| `capabilities` | `string[]` | yes | `each item: at most 72 characters; each item: capability must be a core scope or x.<pluginId>.<name>; at most 32 item(s)` |
| `contributes` | `{ capabilities?: object[], widgets?: object[], behaviors?: object[], commands?: object[], surfaces?: object[], settings?: object, services?: object[], mcp?: object }` | no | — |

`engines.app` and `engines.contracts` are semver ranges the host checks before
a plugin loads; `engines.platforms` narrows to `darwin`/`linux`/`win32`.
`entries` names BUILT `.js` artifacts, `./`-relative, inside the plugin
directory. `host` applies only to `entries.service` and defaults to `worker`.

## Cross-field invariants

These are checked together, after the field rules. The message column is what
the schema itself says — `check` prints it verbatim with a pointer.

| rule | pointer | message |
| --- | --- | --- |
| a contribution that renders needs a renderer entry | `entries` | widgets require entries.renderer |
| dynamic services and contributed MCP tools need a service entry | `entries` | dynamic services and contributed MCP tools require entries.service |
| declaring dynamic services requires the services.provide capability | `capabilities` | declaring dynamic services requires the services.provide capability |
| settings access from code requires storage.self | `capabilities` | settings access from code requires the storage.self capability |
| canvas behaviors require canvas.write | `capabilities` | canvas behaviors require the canvas.write capability |
| onStartup is a background power, and pays the honesty tax | `activation` | onStartup requires entries.service |
| onStartup is a background power, and pays the honesty tax | `capabilities` | onStartup requires the background capability |
| onStartup is a background power, and pays the honesty tax | `backgroundReason` | onStartup requires a non-empty backgroundReason |
| every contributed name is owned by the plugin's id | `contributes.widgets` | `widget type someone.else.card must be com.example.demo or com.example.demo.<name>` |
| ids are unique within their collection | `contributes` | duplicate widget types: com.example.demo.card |
| conflict groups name declared props, and each prop joins at most one | `contributes.widgets.0` | group names undeclared prop missing |
| an immutable prop belongs to no conflict group | `contributes.widgets.0` | immutable prop text must not belong to a conflict group |
| a prop default must satisfy its own prop spec | `contributes.widgets.0` | enum default c not in options for prop mode |
| `a service namespace is x.<pluginId>` | `contributes.services` | service namespace x.com.example.other must be x.com.example.demo |
| an activation event names something the plugin declares | `activation` | activation event onWidget:com.example.demo.nothing names no owned declaration |

## Activation events

`activation` lists the events that make the host load the plugin:

- `onStartup` — service entries only, requires the `background` capability and a
  `backgroundReason` that says why in the user's words.
- `onWidget:<widget type>`, `onCommand:<command id>`, `onSurface:<surface id>`,
  `onService:<x.pluginId.method>` — each must name something this manifest
  declares.

An empty `activation` list is legal: the plugin is registered, and loads when
something it contributes is first reached.

## Capabilities

`capabilities` is a REQUEST, and it is a ceiling rather than a grant: the host
intersects it with what the entry kind may hold, what the user has revoked, and
what the source policy allows. A capability the renderer may not hold is denied
with `entry-kind` even when the manifest asks for it.

| capability | renderer | service |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `agent.control` | yes | — |
| `agent.observe` | yes | yes |
| `agent.spawn` | yes | — |
| `approval.respond` | yes | yes |
| `artifact.publish` | yes | yes |
| `background` | — | yes |
| `canvas.read` | yes | yes |
| `canvas.write` | yes | yes |
| `doc.read` | yes | yes |
| `doc.write` | yes | yes |
| `index.read` | yes | yes |
| `mcp.consume` | yes | yes |
| `mcp.contribute` | — | yes |
| `net.outbound` | — | yes |
| `process.spawn` | — | yes |
| `services.provide` | — | yes |
| `shell.clipboard` | yes | — |
| `shell.dialog` | yes | — |
| `shell.open` | yes | — |
| `shell.webcontents` | yes | — |
| `shell.windows` | yes | — |
| `storage.self` | yes | yes |
| `terminal.attach` | yes | — |
| `workspace.read` | yes | yes |

Anything absent from this table is not plugin-eligible at all. A plugin may also
declare its OWN capabilities (`x.<pluginId>.<name>`) to gate calls into its
dynamic service methods — see `contributions.md`.

## Limits

Every string and collection in a manifest is bounded (§7.1). The numbers:

| limit | value |
| --- | --- |
| `MANIFEST_MAX_BYTES` | 262144 |
| `ID_MAX` | 64 |
| `TITLE_MAX` | 80 |
| `TEXT_MAX` | 500 |
| `PATH_MAX` | 256 |
| `PREVIEW_MAX` | 400 |
| `WIDGETS_MAX` | 64 |
| `PROPS_MAX` | 64 |
| `PORTS_MAX` | 16 |
| `COMMANDS_MAX` | 64 |
| `SURFACES_MAX` | 32 |
| `BEHAVIORS_MAX` | 16 |
| `BEHAVIOR_SCHEMA_FIELDS_MAX` | 64 |
| `BEHAVIOR_READS_MAX` | 64 |
| `BEHAVIOR_WRITES_MAX` | 64 |
| `BEHAVIOR_MIGRATIONS_MAX` | 64 |
| `WIDGET_BEHAVIORS_MAX` | 16 |
| `BEHAVIOR_EPHEMERAL_ENVELOPE_BYTES` | 256 |
| `BEHAVIOR_EPHEMERAL_WINDOW_BYTES` | 49152 |
| `BEHAVIOR_EPHEMERAL_FACET_BYTES_MAX` | 48896 |
| `SERVICE_METHODS_MAX` | 64 |
| `SETTINGS_MAX` | 64 |
| `CAPABILITIES_MAX` | 32 |
| `ACTIVATION_MAX` | 64 |
| `BEHAVIOR_BUDGET_MS_MAX` | 16 |
| `RENDERER_ACTIVATE_DEADLINE_MS` | 5000 |
| `SERVICE_ACTIVATE_DEADLINE_MS` | 10000 |
| `DEACTIVATE_DEADLINE_MS` | 5000 |
| `KV_VALUE_MAX_BYTES` | 65536 |
| `KV_TOTAL_MAX_BYTES` | 10485760 |
| `FILE_QUOTA_BYTES` | 104857600 |

## A manifest that uses most of it

```json
{
  "manifestVersion": 1,
  "id": "com.example.metrics",
  "version": "1.2.0",
  "title": "Metrics",
  "engines": {
    "app": "^0.1.0",
    "contracts": "^0.1.0",
    "platforms": [
      "darwin",
      "linux"
    ]
  },
  "entries": {
    "renderer": "./dist/renderer.js",
    "service": "./dist/service.js"
  },
  "host": "worker",
  "activation": [
    "onService:x.com.example.metrics.snapshot",
    "onWidget:com.example.metrics.chart"
  ],
  "capabilities": [
    "services.provide",
    "storage.self",
    "canvas.read",
    "canvas.write",
    "doc.write",
    "mcp.contribute",
    "x.com.example.metrics.read"
  ],
  "contributes": {
    "capabilities": [
      {
        "id": "x.com.example.metrics.read",
        "title": "Read local metrics",
        "description": "Returns the metrics collected by this plugin",
        "risk": "read"
      }
    ],
    "widgets": [
      {
        "type": "com.example.metrics.chart",
        "title": "Metrics chart",
        "schemaVersion": 1,
        "surface": "dom",
        "sizeMode": "fixed",
        "defaultSize": {
          "w": 329,
          "h": 155
        },
        "ports": [
          {
            "id": "out",
            "side": "e",
            "accepts": [
              "signal"
            ]
          }
        ],
        "props": {
          "source": {
            "kind": "string",
            "maxLength": 200
          }
        },
        "groups": {
          "source": [
            "source"
          ]
        },
        "behaviors": [
          {
            "id": "com.example.metrics:ticker"
          }
        ]
      }
    ],
    "behaviors": [
      {
        "id": "com.example.metrics:ticker",
        "reason": "advance the live sparkline between service snapshots",
        "definition": {
          "store": "runtime",
          "derived": false,
          "deriveDuringGesture": false,
          "version": 1,
          "phase": "simulate",
          "budgetMs": 1,
          "tickWhile": "all",
          "schema": [],
          "reads": [],
          "writes": [],
          "migrationFrom": [],
          "hooks": [
            "tick"
          ]
        }
      }
    ],
    "settings": {
      "properties": {
        "sampleHz": {
          "title": "Sample rate",
          "scope": "user",
          "schema": {
            "type": "number",
            "minimum": 1,
            "maximum": 60,
            "default": 10
          }
        }
      }
    },
    "services": [
      {
        "namespace": "x.com.example.metrics",
        "methods": [
          {
            "name": "snapshot",
            "kind": "query",
            "requiredCapability": "x.com.example.metrics.read",
            "idempotent": true,
            "locality": "local",
            "input": {
              "type": "object",
              "additionalProperties": false
            },
            "output": {
              "type": "object",
              "required": [
                "sampledAt",
                "values"
              ],
              "properties": {
                "sampledAt": {
                  "type": "number"
                },
                "values": {
                  "type": "array",
                  "items": {
                    "type": "number"
                  },
                  "maxItems": 1000
                }
              },
              "additionalProperties": false
            }
          }
        ]
      }
    ],
    "mcp": {
      "tools": [
        {
          "name": "metrics-snapshot",
          "title": "Metrics snapshot",
          "description": "Read the current metrics sample",
          "method": "x.com.example.metrics.snapshot"
        }
      ]
    }
  }
}
```
